papers.title: The Mirage of Optimizing Training Policies: Monotonic Inference Policies as the Real Objective for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for LLMs faces instability due to training-inference mismatch. The paper proposes Monotonic Inference Policy Improvement (MIPI) and framework MIPU to ensure consistent policy improvements between training and inference phases.

papers.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.abstract: A portable C++ runtime enabling efficient deployment of vision-language-action and world-action models across heterogeneous edge devices through modular execution layers and optimized inference strategies.

papers.title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization method for diffusion transformers using normalized rotated basis, eliminating recalibration needs across timesteps and modalities for efficient image and video generation.

papers.title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
papers.abstract: Lightweight framework addressing action chunking limitations in vision-language-action models through latent-space vision monitoring and adaptive corrective replanning for robust manipulation tasks.

papers.title: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
papers.abstract: Framework treating memory management as a trainable skill for LLMs, automating both memory structure optimization and proficiency enhancement, yielding 2x-4x improvements in long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: DataComp-VLM: Improved Open Datasets for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Comprehensive benchmark for evaluating data curation strategies in vision-language models, demonstrating that data mixing rather than filtering significantly improves performance at scale.

papers.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
papers.abstract: Open-source framework organizing AI red teaming across infrastructure, protocol, agent behavior, and model layers, including supply-chain auditing of agent skills and components.

papers.title: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
papers.abstract: Framework inferring training data compositions from released model weights by analyzing geometric footprints in weight space through model merging and feature extraction techniques.

papers.title: Interpretation-Oriented Cloud Removal via Observation-Anchored Residual Flow with Geo-Contextual Alignment
papers.abstract: Cloud removal framework addressing semantic drift through physically grounded residual inversion combined with semantic manifold constraints from vision foundation models for remote sensing.

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Quantum-Inspired Fast Weight Programmers for Traffic-Matrix Forecasting
papers.abstract: Quantum-inspired recurrent models using gated QKAN-FWPs demonstrate superior forecasting accuracy with reduced computational requirements for network traffic-matrix prediction tasks.

cc_updates.body: Claude Sonnet 5 sessions no longer use the mid-conversation system role for harness reminders

Changed AskUserQuestion dialogs to no longer auto-continue by default; opt into an idle timeout via /config. Changed the "default" permission mode to "Manual" across the CLI, --help, VS Code, and JetBrains. Fixed a crash at startup when disabledMcpServers or enabledMcpServers in .claude.json is set to a non-array value. Fixed background sessions silently stopping mid-turn after sleep/wake or when reopening a stalled session. Fixed background sessions re-running a turn cancelled with Esc after a stall respawn. Fixed background-agent daemon handover so a reinstalled older build can no longer take over the daemon. Fixed background-agent roster issues including transient corruption. Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit returning an empty result instead of failing cleanly. Fixed control bytes from background-agent output reaching the terminal. Multiple additional fixes for plugins, MCP servers, voice dictation, screen readers, and the install script.

Stacked slash-skill invocations like /skill-a /skill-b do XYZ now load all leading skills (up to 5), not just the first. Fixed SSL certificate errors (TLS-inspecting proxies, missing NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, expired certs) burning retries before showing actionable guidance. Fixed streaming responses being discarded when the API emits a mid-stream overloaded/server error after partial output. Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit or server error silently failing instead of returning their partial work to the parent. Fixed subagents reporting API errors as successful results. Fixed the background-agent daemon on Linux killing itself after an unclean shutdown. Fixed background agents failing to cold-start over SSH on macOS. Multiple additional reliability and UX improvements for background sessions, MCP servers, and agent management.
